digest.component_or_area: plan review attestation and code-drift detection
propositions: Unscoped no-file-impact tickets currently invalidate on any code-SHA change, causing 21% of re-reviews to run on byte-identical material; the design scopes this fail-safe to the recorded read-set plus blast-radius entries.

The signed manifest must record normalized read paths (tool=read_file only, deduplicated, repo-relative, existing files only) and include a read-set marker; any modification to the read-set must fail verification and trigger invalidation.

SHA drift re-hashing must apply read-set scoping only when all four preconditions hold: empty pre-existing dependency set, no container poison, undeclared scope, and a recorded read-set; otherwise it falls back to whole-HEAD invalidation.

Blast-radius entries (rebar.toml, criteria files, reviewers, gates) must be expanded at attestation time into per-file hashes and a membership digest to catch both content and membership changes, using a single dispatching helper.

The signed manifest must record an authenticated currency-basis field (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) and plan_review_status must report it; unverifiable read-sets and expansion failures must fall back to invalidate-on-any-change.
